title: Far Infrared Irradiation for Stroke Rehabilitation
brief_summary: A stroke is a sudden loss of brain function. It is caused by the interruption of flow of blood to the brain (ischemic stroke) or the rupture of blood vessels in the brain (hemorrhagic stroke). This study will investigate the use of far infrared radiation for stroke rehabilitation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* People with Stroke

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
